description:
ArtifactNode records the artifacts (Rulesfile, Plugin and Config) assigned to one node of a
namespace and their per-node state. One ArtifactNode exists per namespace and node that runs a
Falco pod. Its spec is written by the instance operator and its status by the artifact operator
running on that node.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: Spec is required, so the apiserver also enforces NodeName's own required constraint within it.

artifacts.description: Artifacts is the set of artifacts assigned to the node. Entries are unique by kind and name.

items.description:
NodeArtifactRef identifies one artifact assigned to a node. The artifact lives in the namespace of
the ArtifactNode that lists it.

kind.description: Kind is the kind of the assigned artifact.

name.description: Name is the name of the assigned artifact.

uid.description:
UID is the UID of the artifact object the assignment was made for. It tells a deleted and
recreated artifact of the same name apart from its predecessor.

nodeName.description: NodeName is the name of the node the artifacts are assigned to.

status.description: ArtifactNodeStatus defines the observed state of the artifacts assigned to a node.

artifacts.description: Artifacts is the per-artifact state, written exclusively by the artifact operator on the node.

items.description:
NodeArtifactStatus is the state of one assigned artifact on the node, as reported by the artifact
operator running there.

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the artifact's state on this node.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.

installedArtifacts.description:
InstalledArtifacts tracks the artifact files currently written to disk for this artifact.
Each entry corresponds to one source medium (oci, inline, configmap).

items.description:
InstalledArtifact describes a single artifact file currently on disk.
The medium field is the list map key: at most one entry per medium exists.

contentHash.description:
ContentHash is the SHA-256 hex digest of the bytes written to disk.
A mismatch between this value and the current source signals that the file must be re-written.

path.description: Path is the absolute on-disk path of the installed file.

priority.description: Priority is the load-order value encoded in the filename.

specHash.description:
SpecHash is the SHA-256 hash of the parent artifact's OCIArtifact spec at the time this
artifact was installed. Populated only for MediumOCI. A mismatch with the parent
artifact's current ArtifactMeta.SpecHash means the remote blob may have changed and the
artifact must be re-fetched regardless of disk integrity.

kind.description: Kind is the kind of the artifact this entry reports on.

name.description: Name is the name of the artifact this entry reports on.

uid.description:
UID is the UID of the artifact object this entry reports on. An entry whose UID differs from
the assignment's describes a previous incarnation of the artifact and must be ignored.
